name: 吳斯偉
objective: This course is to analyze the macroeconomic policy, international economy, business cycles, government policy, exchange rate and other macroeconomic-related issues. The course will be taught with case studies and journal literature. Group discussions are needed.
課程進度(1-16週):
a 週次	單元
一	Introduction
二	The data of macroeconomics
三	National income
四	Money and inflation
五	The open economy
六	Unemployment
七	Economic growth I
八	Economic growth II
九	Midterm exam
十	Economic fluctuations
十一	Aggregate demand
十二	Aggregate supply
十三	IS - LM model I
十四	IS - LM model II
十五	IS - LM model III
十六	Macroeconomic policy
十七	 Review
十八	Final
彈性學習(17-18週):
類別
		  
		    ● 學生分組實作及討論 (Student group practice and discussion)

● 參與校內外活動 (講座、工作坊、參訪) 或競賽 (Participation in on-campus or off-campus activities (lectures, workshops, visits) or competitions)
● 線上數位教材學習 (Coursera、edX、磨課師等)(Online digital learning (Coursera, edX, MOOCs, etc.))
